title: Indexing
statement:
Arrays are **zero-indexed**: the first element is at index **0**, the second at **1**, and so on.

Read **n**, the array, and an index **k**. Print the value **a[k]**.
ioRules:
- Line 1: **n** (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000)
- Line 2: **n** integers
- Line 3: **k** (0 ≤ k < n)
- Output: single integer — the value at index k
